profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer – Focus on High Performance Computing & IoT Product Development ➤Full Technology Stack – Software, Hardware, Firmware Architectures ➤Track record of success in startup & Fortune 500s
profile.summary:
💡 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐨𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐅𝐮𝐞𝐥𝐬 𝐈𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
From building my first computer in 8th grade to diving into computer engineering, electronics, robotics, and programming in high school, my curiosity and passion for technology have driven my career.

I thrive on challenges and opportunities to use new technology, be it a programming language, tool, or framework, to solve real-world problems in diverse application areas.

💻 𝐅𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐅𝐢𝐫𝐦𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐒𝐨𝐟𝐭𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞/𝐇𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞
While pursuing my B.S. in computer science and electrical engineering, I built a robust project portfolio that exposed me to diverse technical domains, from machine learning and image processing to kernel development and embedded systems.

Before graduating, I had a couple of internships where I worked with multidisciplinary teams in diverse settings, including a data center startup and a multinational Agile/Scrum environment. These experiences immersed me in challenges involving Linux hosting systems, virtual machines, and networking cybersecurity measures.

Along the way, I gained invaluable experience working with cross-functional teams to apply various software, hardware, and firmware fundamentals to real-world problems.

🌟 𝐒𝐨𝐟𝐭𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫 & 𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐮𝐦 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫
As a software engineer, I have led and supported geographically dispersed teams in building, validating, and implementing hardware, software, and firmware architectures for next-gen IoT products.

My leadership, teamwork, and communication skills have been instrumental in self-directed roles that involve bridging gaps between technical complexities and business goals and driving project success as a Scrum Master.

🧰 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐠𝐲 𝐓𝐨𝐨𝐥𝐛𝐨𝐱
𝑃𝑟𝑜𝑔𝑟𝑎𝑚𝑚𝑖𝑛𝑔: Python, Java, C/C++, R, Vb.NET, Bash, Verilog, MATLAB, Arduino, OpenMP, Git, GitHub

𝑆𝑜𝑓𝑡𝑤𝑎𝑟𝑒: MobaXterm, WSL2.0, Eclipse, Simulink, Visual Studio, Intel Quartus, IntelliJ, SigmaStudio, LabVIEW, MPLABX, Xilinx Vivado, RStudio, Atlassian JIRA, Confluence

𝐻𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑤𝑎𝑟𝑒: Bus Analyzers (PCIE 3.0/4.0, SAS/SATA), PIC24, ARM/MIPS Softcore Processors

🎶 𝐏𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐁𝐞𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐝 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡
My interests are vast, from building speaker systems to designing indoor air quality monitoring and filtering systems. I am constantly looking for opportunities that leverage my natural curiosity to innovate.

When not immersed in tech, I practice yoga, kickboxing, and studying the latest hardware and software innovations.

positions.title: Software Engineer I ➤High-Performance Computing Products ➤Global Collaboration in Agile Settings
positions.description:
•	
I have continued to support software development in Java and C++ on HPC networking products alongside geographically dispersed teams across multiple time zones in an agile environment. Here's a glimpse into my journey:

Embracing agile methodologies, I attend and actively participate in ceremonies, utilizing JIRA and Confluence to foster collaboration and organized work.

🧭 𝐍𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐠𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐀𝐏𝐈 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
Tasked with preparing our Java Native Programming Interface (JNI) for a new hardware revision, I faced the challenge of dynamically loading the correct library on startup, with limited guidance and mentorship.

I immersed myself in the codebase, reviewed technical design documents, and consulted with senior engineers to devise a solution. By implementing a singleton pattern with a facade pattern, I facilitated loading at runtime and underwent formal code review to ensure alignment with project objectives.

Despite the initial hurdles, my efforts propelled the project forward, marking significant progress in our software development efforts.

🎯 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐆𝐢𝐭 𝐁𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐡 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭
I was confronted with single-handedly rebasing a branch significantly behind the master.

I meticulously compared code variants, resolved merge conflicts, and conducted thorough testing to validate the integrity of the branch. My diligent efforts resulted in a branch that closely mirrored the master.

We achieved a more streamlined and synchronized development environment, enhancing collaboration and productivity across the team.

positions.title: System Software Engineer I ➤Scrum Master ➤Linux Kernel Development ➤Agile Software Integration
positions.description:
My Linux server management and programming background captured attention and led to my hire in this remote role, focused on designing and integrating software systems across multiple platforms within the global Business Unit (BU).

I have had the opportunity to serve as a Scrum Master, leading Scrum ceremonies, including daily standups, backlog refinements, sprint planning, retrospectives, and more.

🌐 𝐑𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐞 𝐒𝐨𝐟𝐭𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
I played a key role in shaping Linux kernel development in Bash and C and Jenkins pipeline building and testing activities.

I have also investigated and validated virtual machine test methods, created and executed test plans, performed system debugging, and designed scripts and tools that streamlined product integration within agile environments.

🎯 𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐮𝐦 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩
We lacked a dedicated Scrum Master to facilitate meetings and ceremonies. Recognizing my aptitude for running meetings, I was appointed Scrum Master for a team of 12 engineers.

Working directly with the Lead Scrum Master, I developed and implemented efficient meeting strategies, including 1:1 sessions and agile development processes. I also managed conflicts and communicated project status issues to the Product Owner.

Under my leadership, our team meetings became more efficient and effective, substantially improving our planning and review processes and overall project success.

🛠️ 𝐁𝐨𝐨𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐓𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐜𝐞𝐬
Our team faced persistent challenges in obtaining development systems, which, in turn, hindered our productivity and progress. Collaborating with developers, I initiated a deep dive assessment into a new virtual system to understand its capability gaps and address issues through testing and development support.

Through our virtualization approach, we secured more testing resources, increasing productivity by about 25%.

positions.title: Electrical Characterization Engineer ➤Application Development – Accelerating Test Plan Completion
positions.description:
I had the opportunity to intern with a multidisciplinary team specializing in electrical power testing and software development in Tcl and VB.Net for prototype products and HDD/SSD software.

Simultaneously, I was exposed to the challenges and excitement of working with remote and international teams spread across different time zones to diagnose and resolve various hardware, software, and hosting issues, from routine to complex.

🌟 𝐀𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 – 𝐀𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭
One of my notable achievements was supporting the development of a comprehensive application to monitor and manage 40 different test systems, each of which ran test plans on HDD and SSD products.

We often encountered issues with system crashes and delays in test plan completion as we could not accurately monitor the status of each system in real-time.

In collaboration with another engineer, I developed an application that simultaneously provided real-time data on all test systems. This involved understanding the scale of the problem, conceptualizing the application, and implementing it using Vb.NET with hooks into our software using Tcl.

With the new application in place, we could quickly identify crashed systems and estimate test phase completion time, significantly reducing downtime and accelerating test plan completion by about 30%.

🛠️ 𝐀𝐝𝐯𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐝 𝐇𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞 & 𝐒𝐨𝐟𝐭𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐃𝐞𝐛𝐮𝐠𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠
Using various debugging tools, including PCIE 3.0/4.0 and SATA Bus Analyzers, alongside high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, I strengthened my problem-solving skills by identifying drive issues and failures and ensuring product reliability and performance.

🔍 𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐚 𝐀𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐲𝐬𝐢𝐬 & 𝐓𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠
I analyzed large test datasets in Excel, spotting trends and patterns to improve testing efficiency, and worked with Linux and Windows platforms to maintain desktops, troubleshoot systems, and develop floor control and automation programs.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant ➤Empowering Students in Microprocessors – MCU Cores, Sensors & Circuit Debugging
positions.description:
•	As a TA for the Microprocessors class, I helped students understand the complexities of microcontroller units (MCUs).

⚒️ 𝐇𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐬-𝐨𝐧 𝐋𝐚𝐛 𝐒𝐮𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭
From troubleshooting to circuit construction, I guided students in numerous lab activities that involved building a complete MCU circuit using a DIP package PIC24 MCU.

I also increased students' understanding of microprocessor fundamentals and other essential topics, such as MCU core features, timing, sensors, and peripherals.

🔎 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐦 𝐃𝐞𝐛𝐮𝐠𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐀𝐢𝐝
Whether it was assembly, C, or C++, I supported students in debugging their programs using Microchip MPLABX and in-circuit debuggers.

I also assisted in debugging breadboard circuits, integrating various sensors and hardware devices to support their learning experiences.
positions.insights: Technical Engineering, Software Project Management and +9 skills

positions.title: Tier II Datacenter Technician ➤Data Center Operations – Hardware, Network & VM Optimization
positions.locationName: Port Edwards, Wisconsin, United States · On-site
positions.description:
I gained valuable computer hardware and networking experience in a start-up environment.

From fulfilling physical server build orders for customers to configuring virtual environments using Proxmox and VMware hypervisors, this experience laid the groundwork for future hardware assembly and software configuration challenges.

As part of routine maintenance, I diagnosed and performed troubleshooting on network connectivity challenges between virtual machines and client devices, ensuring seamless communication within the data center ecosystem.

🖥️ 𝐁𝐨𝐨𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐕𝐌 𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞
Our team was facing complaints from a customer about insufficient data rates for their virtual machines, which resulted in sluggish system performance. We investigated the problem, diving into the data center's infrastructure and identifying a bottleneck in the network.

By strategically adding a second ethernet connection to the switch, we could double the available network bandwidth to the affected systems. We executed a late-night mission to upgrade the servers during off hours. This approach minimized business disruptions and significantly increased VM performance, resulting in a happy customer.

🚧 𝐎𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐒𝐞𝐭𝐮𝐩 𝐇𝐮𝐫𝐝𝐥𝐞𝐬
Setting up a Proxmox hypervisor and pfSense firewall was challenging due to compatibility issues.

I sought advice from my colleagues in the data center to explore alternative options to overcome the configuration issues. After identifying a software and hardware issue, I initiated and guided the transition to a secure ESXi environment, allowing experimentation without disrupting data center operations.
positions.insights: Customer Support, Computer Hardware Troubleshooting and +4 skills

projects.title: Airline Management & Ticketing System in C++
projects.description:
✈️ 𝐂𝐫𝐚𝐟𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐄𝐟𝐟𝐢𝐜𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐀𝐢𝐫𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐒𝐨𝐥𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬
I developed a system for tracking fictional airline customers and flight classes.

Using C++, I created several data structures from scratch and leveraged pointers for their implementation. Finally, I integrated FIFOs and priority queues into the system architecture, which proved instrumental in prioritizing tasks, managing resources, and optimizing efficiency.

projects.title: Audio Engineering | Digital Signal Processing (DSP) Based Active Crossover System
projects.description:
🔊 𝐄𝐥𝐞𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐀𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐨 𝐐𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐃𝐒𝐏 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐠𝐲
One of my passions includes audio technology.

I aimed to enhance speaker system performance using digital signal processing (DSP) techniques. I evaluated DSP boards and development tools, selecting the most suitable hardware and software solutions to fine-tune frequencies.

Using speaker specifications as a guide, I chose cutoff frequencies to filter audio signals across various frequencies. Finally, I used Analog Devices SigmaStudio to implement Equalizers and High-Pass (HP) and Low-Pass (LP) filters to fine-tune the audio output.

experience.title: Electrical Characterization Engineer ➤Application Development – Accelerating Test Plan Completion
experience.description:
I had the opportunity to intern with a multidisciplinary team specializing in electrical power testing and software development in Tcl and VB.Net for prototype products and HDD/SSD software.

Simultaneously, I was exposed to the challenges and excitement of working with remote and international teams spread across different time zones to diagnose and resolve various hardware, software, and hosting issues, from routine to complex.

🌟 𝐀𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 – 𝐀𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭
One of my notable achievements was supporting the development of a comprehensive application to monitor and manage 40 different test systems, each of which ran test plans on HDD and SSD products.

We often encountered issues with system crashes and delays in test plan completion as we could not accurately monitor the status of each system in real-time.

In collaboration with another engineer, I developed an application that simultaneously provided real-time data on all test systems. This involved understanding the scale of the problem, conceptualizing the application, and implementing it using Vb.NET with hooks into our software using Tcl.

With the new application in place, we could quickly identify crashed systems and estimate test phase completion time, significantly reducing downtime and accelerating test plan completion by about 30%.

🛠️ 𝐀𝐝𝐯𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐝 𝐇𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞 & 𝐒𝐨𝐟𝐭𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐃𝐞𝐛𝐮𝐠𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠
Using various debugging tools, including PCIE 3.0/4.0 and SATA Bus Analyzers, alongside high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, I strengthened my problem-solving skills by identifying drive issues and failures and ensuring product reliability and performance.

🔍 𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐚 𝐀𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐲𝐬𝐢𝐬 & 𝐓𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠
